H01.description: Header comment updated to document the opt-in workspace head fallback and head_dir_source introduced by the D1 fix.

H02.description: When EVAL_HEAD_DIR and the fixture head are absent, the grader silently falls back to <workspace>/pr/head, which is the graded agent's own writable tree, letting the graded agent influence same-function crediting.

H03.description: Markdown header detection treats `#` lines inside fenced code blocks as headings, splitting a section's scope at code comments.

H04.description: Bash closing-brace detection measures indentation without expanding tabs while headers() measures tab-expanded width, so tab-indented functions never match their closing brace and their scope runs too far.

H05.description: Python end-of-definition detection starts right after the def line, so a multi-line signature's dedented closing `):` line ends the definition before its body.

H06.description: Adds the HEADERS_CAP constant used by the D5 fix.

H07.description: scope_map has no bound on the number of headers, so a large file with many unterminated headers triggers a quadratic span scan (resource exhaustion on agent-influenced input).

H08.description: Reports head_dir_source in details as part of the D1 fix.

H09.description: grade_recall drops EVAL_HEAD_DIR when no PR fixture head exists, letting recall-vs-defects.sh fall back to the sandbox's agent-writable pr/head copy.

H10.description: Caller updated to pass the tool name to the new repo_name_exempt signature (D6 fix).

H11.description: Comment updated to describe the logical-line and bare-token rules.

H12.description: repo_name_exempt exempts a Bash command that actually reaches the upstream repository (curl/git/gh with 0xHoneyJar/loa) whenever the same line appears in the PR fixture, and ignores backslash-continued lines, hiding real contamination.

H13.description: A bare repo-name token standing as a whole line becomes its own unit, which is a substring of every fixture token line, so it is always exempt even when used as a command argument.

H14.description: corpus_sha256 validates the file with read_regular and then reopens it with plain open(), following symlinks and unbounded, so it can hash a different (swapped or oversized) file than the one checked.

H15.description: Comment updated to describe the extended silent-sink and redirection rules.

H16.description: Adds the input-bound constants and ORACLE_SKIPPED list used by the D11 fix.

H17.description: SILENT_SINK only recognises a counting/quiet grep flag as the first argument and misses egrep/fgrep/-L, so `diff … | grep -i -c x` is treated as printing diff content and falsely marks defects exposed.

H18.description: The segment splitter treats `&` in redirections like 2>&1, >&2, &> and `|&` as a command separator, breaking the pipe association so `diff … 2>&1 | wc -l` is read as an unpiped content diff.

H19.description: expand() has no cap on the cartesian product of for-list variable substitutions, so agent-authored commands can blow up grading time/memory.

H20.description: segment_tokens runs PATHISH and expansion over arbitrarily large agent-authored segments and words without any size bound.

H21.description: The oracle scan runs difflib SequenceMatcher on arbitrarily long head and sandbox copies, an unbounded (quadratic) cost on agent-controlled file size.

H22.description: Tool result text is processed with no bound on line count or line length.

H23.description: for-list word lists are stored unbounded, feeding the expansion blow-up.

H24.description: The diff-form check misses silent sinks with flags after the first argument and treats stat-only `git diff --stat/--name-only` as printing content, producing false oracle exposures.

H25.description: Adds the oracle_scan_skipped field to the grade.json skeleton for the D11 fix.

H26.description: Clears and records ORACLE_SKIPPED around oracle_scan for the D11 fix.

I01.description: KF-046 history of contamination-scan false positives fixed in earlier grader versions; the 1.3.0 entries are a true positive and a new class-8 candidate, not a head defect shown here.

I02.description: The 1.3.0 oracle detector skips every tool_result flagged is_error, but a differing diff exits 1 and is error-marked, so real diff exposures can go undetected (fixed in grader 1.3.1).

I03.description: A model refusal fallback in pipeline-run.sh is designed behaviour in a file outside the hunks shown, not a defect at head.
